title: Unit: maps, communications, records, and deployment work
audience: Crews using Unit for shared situational awareness, field documentation, and deployment support.
summary: Use the wider field workspace while keeping location, provider, record, and reporting states honest across browser and native platforms.
prerequisites: Populated map pins, POIs, custom and indoor maps, valid mapping access, and prepared weather-alert examples.
Chat, assistant, voice, audio streams, notifications, and references configured only for the corresponding branches.
Records.System and Records.Field.Unit enabled with supported forms and assignments; operations access with rostered crew and optional costing/MARS data.
A native device for background location, camera, Bluetooth, hardware PTT, and phone-notification captures; browser results do not establish native behavior.

scenes.title: Follow the apparatus and control the map
scenes.capture_intent: Capture legible real cartography and current unit; review named lock/unlock icons with DOM bounds and actual image review; show recenter only if genuinely offered. Use actual application screenshots and observed controls; source support alone is not capture proof.
scenes.narration: The main map uses the active unit’s operational context. Lock map to unit and Unlock map are accessible names on icon controls; inspect the real icons and map response. Recenter appears after manual exploration when a usable position exists. A wildland crew or security patrol still needs current location data. Unit already has web map components; browser cartography and native background location require separate verification.
scenes.practice: Pan around a fictional response area, return to the selected unit, and explain the difference between the marker and a verified live background update.

scenes.title: Set reliable preferences and verify recovery
scenes.capture_intent: Show actual browser settings/toggles, shared installation and logout views. Explain the source-defined Android-only Modern Notification Sounds control explicitly; do not require it in browser shots. No GPS/audio/notification permission, native background or durable-storage success claim. Retain only actually visible and reviewed controls.
scenes.narration: Settings offers language, theme, Background Geolocation, Realtime Geolocation, and Keep Alive. Unit defaults realtime sharing on; confirm the actual state and device permissions before duty. Modern Notification Sounds appears only on Android, so it is absent here. These controls do not prove a notification or location update succeeded. Checklist web storage is memory-only, record offline support depends on its definition, and inventory counts save to the server. Verify native storage, hardware, and background delivery separately.
scenes.practice: Choose suitable preferences for a training vehicle, inspect a queued feature’s recovery, and list the native notification or offline branches still unverified.

source_workflow_reference.title: Set reliable preferences and verify recovery
source_workflow_reference.narration: In Settings, review language, theme, notification sounds, Background Geolocation, Realtime Geolocation, and Keep Alive for the actual device and duty. These settings have different effects on location, received updates, battery, and screen behavior. Inspect real permission views and a test notification separately. After lost connectivity, review queued work and synchronization for the specific feature; a browser session cannot demonstrate durable native offline storage or background delivery.
